name: Asset Inventory
description: Physical devices and systems within the organization must be inventoried.

name: Access Control
description: Access permissions and authorizations must be managed incorporating the principles of least privilege and separation of duties.

name: Audit and Accountability
description: Audit logging and accountability mechanisms must be enabled and reviewed for anomalous activity.

name: Incident Management
description: Response processes and procedures must be established and maintained to ensure timely response to detected cybersecurity incidents.

name: Network Protection
description: Network integrity must be protected by incorporating network segmentation where appropriate.
